limits: Only explicit completed/refused record groups are selected; no instrument ownership or final bench state is inferred.
Controller success alone did not prove image integrity: the first IDMA build wrote zeros and remains failed.
LINE overlap used warm preinitialized SD and diagnostic snapshots; it is not a cold-start energy measurement or a PVT visibility guarantee.
All-capacity format initializes slot headers; it does not validate physical capacity, erase every payload sector, or qualify arbitrary power loss.
Scene photo pixels are omitted. Captured payloads here are explicitly verified test-pattern runs or their failed SD readback.
Frozen generated sources and binary bytes are retained; external vendor/toolchain dependencies are not a portable build closure.
Tool files are labeled archive-time snapshots, not asserted to be the exact versions executed for every historical run.
Awake-cycle01 ends in an awake park, not Standby. Its strict phase decoder failed and remains failed.
Scene readback integrity is a retained historical comparison with matching hashes; omitted scene pixels cannot be independently replayed here.
The v9 DMA-WFI run failed before commit. Its separate camera-reset and SD-idle diagnostic does not convert that capture into success.
The v14b WFI trial lost debug/SRAM access and has no completion or idle proof; it remains failed and unselected.

Reset and cold abort were explicitly authorized despite unknown storage state. The cold-abort host error restored power through helper cleanup; this is not a qualified recovery protocol or power-loss test.
Restored v9 committed slot3; this does not establish the contents of the interrupted slots or full integrity of earlier photos.
The v12 installation is verified independently of any subsequent capture/Standby/energy qualification.
Three v12 Standby claims combine exact recovery/SBF bytes with root attestations of flag clear and no intervening power-off; a current plateau alone is not the proof.

Energy reports retain native boundaries and signed delivered-sample integrals, including about 7.4 A startup samples under the unchanged 9.5 A validity criterion; no physical-inrush, clipping or isolated battery claim is inferred.
The final Standby marker fails its width bound and remains unknown. Events 1-9 have directly decoded widths; independent JS and Saleae clocks do not support per-phase energy.
Compact native-sample sums reproduce all twelve selected energy intervals and aggregate durations; omitted raw arrays prevent rerunning sample-order onset/plateau classification.
Final metadata shows slots1/2 PARTIAL and slots4/5/6 FULL. Slot6 full read/decode passes but cannot be compared to its original sensor RAM frame after Standby.
Original slot0 preservation is a retained byte-comparison report with matching payload hashes; scene pixels are omitted.
Final cycle04 leaves power on at the observed low-current plateau; its expected slot7 and actual SBF were not reread and remain unverified.
v15 corrects retained late-loader-token boot freshness; v12 timing/energy and handoff remain historical and are not automatically attributed to v15.
v15 slot8 read/decode validates the retrieved RAW and PNG conversion, not equality to the sensor frame that was lost in Standby.
Latest v15 final cycle leaves power on at the observed plateau; its expected slot9 and SBF were not reread. v15 has one separately qualified smoke cycle, while v12 retains its three-cycle baseline.
